quotes.text: The days are long, but the years are short.
quotes.author: Gretchen Rubin

quotes.text: Something as simple as better breastfeeding could save a million children a year.
quotes.author: Anne M. Mulcahy

quotes.text: Just as flowers turn to the sun, babies turn to their mothers. Such is nature's way.
quotes.author: Sara Joy Amin

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is a mother's gift to herself, her baby and the earth.
quotes.author: Pamela K. Wiggins

quotes.text: A baby nursing at a mother's breast is an undeniable affirmation of our rootedness in nature.
quotes.author: David Suzuki

quotes.text: I'm not telling you it's going to be easy. I'm telling you it's going to be worth it.
quotes.author: Art Williams

quotes.text: The moment a child is born, the mother is also born. She never existed before. The woman existed, but the mother, never.
quotes.author: Rajneesh

quotes.text: A newborn has only three demands. They are warmth in the arms of its mother, food from her breasts, and security in the knowledge of her presence. Breastfeeding satisfies all three.
quotes.author: Dr. Grantly Dick-Read

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is an investment in the health and future of the planet.
quotes.author: Ilana Shemesh

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is an instinctual and natural act, but it is also an art that is learned day by day.
quotes.author: La Leche League International

quotes.text: Breastfeeding reminds us of the universal truth of abundance; the more we give out, the more we are filled up...
quotes.author: Sarah Buckley

quotes.text: Mother's milk is, I think, a symbol of compassion.
quotes.author: The Dalai Lama

quotes.text: Human milk is like ice cream, penicillin, and the drug ecstasy all wrapped up in two pretty packages.
quotes.author: Florence Williams

quotes.text: There are three reasons for breastfeeding: first, the milk is always at the right temperature; second, it comes in attractive containers, and third, a cat can't drink it.
quotes.author: Irena Chalmers

quotes.text: They do say breastfeeding is nature's lipo.
quotes.author: Ana Ortiz

quotes.text: My favorite sound is right before a baby latches on; it's this giggle of joy that is heaven sent.
quotes.author: Karalynn

quotes.text: Breastmilk is love turned into food. It takes someone special to share that love.
quotes.author: Human Milk 4 Human Babies

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is about 90% determination and only 10% milk production.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is a gift that lasts a lifetime.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Not all superheroes wear capes, some wear nursing bras!
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: There is nothing better than time spent nourishing your baby.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: You are a ROCKSTAR, whether you nurse for 3 days or 3 years!
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is not always easy, but it is ALWAYS worth it!
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is not just about milk. It's about love, comfort, and security.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is like a new job; it's hard in the beginning, it's easier with practice, and you don't dare quit. Because you'll miss out on all the rewards.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Bottles fill his stomach, but breastfeeding fills his soul.
quotes.author: Diane Wiessinger, IBCLC

quotes.text: It is only in the act of nursing that a woman realizes her motherhood in visible and tangible fashion; it is a joy of every moment.
quotes.author: Honoré de Balzac

quotes.text: Breastfeeding is nature's health plan.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: The moment she had laid the child to the breast both became perfectly calm.
quotes.author: Isak Dinesen
